help.title: Help
help.welcome: Welcome to the BoardSync help page, your guide to using our Kanban project management tool. Here you will find an overview of how to manage projects and organize tasks efficiently.

what.title: What is BoardSync?
what.text1: BoardSync is a modern, Kanban-based project management tool that allows you to visually represent workflows, keep track of tasks, and optimize team collaboration.
what.text2: Kanban helps you divide your tasks into different statuses and track progress in real-time.

steps.title: How to use BoardSync
steps.intro: Here is a step-by-step guide for the most important features:

projects.title: Creating Projects
projects.text: Create new projects via the menu or dashboard to structure your tasks by topic or team.

tasks.title: Adding Tasks
tasks.text: Add specific tasks to your projects. Define titles, descriptions, due dates, and assignees.

board.title: Using the Board
board.text: In the board, you can clearly see all tasks sorted by status.

drag.title: Using Drag & Drop
drag.text: Easily edit and move tasks between different columns via drag & drop to update their status in a flash.

tips.title: Useful Tips
tips.tip1: Keep task titles short and concise so they immediately catch the eye on the Kanban board.
tips.tip2: Assign tasks to clear owners to unambiguously define team responsibilities.
tips.tip3: Regularly use the drag-and-drop feature to keep your team always up to date.
